{{Quote|This experimental weapon is brought to you by Czerka Arms. Use constitutes a waiver, release, and discharge of any and all liability, including but not limited to death, destruction, and general mayhem. You shall not hold Czerka Arms liable for any case or reason whatsoever.|A liability disclaimer of an experimental assault cannon produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]].|<ref name="TORLotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
A '''blaster cannon''', also known as a '''flash cannon''' and '''assault cannons''', was a limited-range heavy artillery variant of the handheld [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Blaster cannons were commonly fitted aboard [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] vehicles;<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> however, a portable shoulder-fired or hip-fired versions were also used to inflict devastation on vehicles, troops, and structures.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

==Description==
[[File:Blastercannon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A mounted blaster cannon]]
Blaster cannons derived their energy from power packs of ionized cryogenic cells. Unlike [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], blaster cannons could be set at various levels of damage, ranging from stun to full power. There existed several designations of blaster cannon strength, including light blaster cannons, medium blaster cannons and heavy blaster cannons.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Blaster cannons were commonly less powerful than laser cannons, though were quite effective during atmospheric combat, especially against ground troops and vehicles.<ref name="TPM" />

Variants of the portable blaster cannon included the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]], the [[BB-23 heavy blaster cannon]], the [[CR-1 blaster cannon/Legends|CR-1 blaster cannon]] and [[CZR-9001 assault cannon]].

==History==
[[File:AT-ST-Endor.png|thumb|right|300px|An AT-ST fires its [[MS-4 twin blaster cannon/Legends|MS-4 twin blaster cannons]]]]
Portable assault cannons were widely used during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the following conflicts. [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] was one of the major manufacturers of the weapon at the time, having produced multiple service and experimental models.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Thousands of years later, hand-held assault cannons were still in common use in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Great Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CloneWars2003">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref>

Notable military vehicles that utilized blaster cannons in their arsenal included the military version [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class urban landspeeder]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]],<ref name="TPM" /> [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] produced by [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]], as well as the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] was similarly equipped with a blaster cannon.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

Certain large [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had blaster cannons built into their chassis. Examples of these included the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]],<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> the [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid]], and the [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The portable version of the blaster cannon was used by [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|spacetroopers]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] was also proficient with this weapon.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[YVH-Series battle droid]] used a variable-powered blaster cannon as its primary weapon.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
